notes.title: Still in development, still working on it.
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you for your interest in the game! I'm still working on it and will be updating the graphics. The reason behind this is that the original 320x180 resolution turned out to be more limiting than I anticipated. I also have plans to introduce some new mechanics. I'll update the screenshots as soon as they're ready. The release is planned for January or early February 2025.

Thank you for your patience!
Rumly
